corrections.why: Firelookout.com says the 70-foot platform is still there (undated page), and the FFLA index row reads Abandoned, not Gone. A recent site check or Ochoco NF contact would confirm before the record changes.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com says the platform is still there; the FFLA index says Abandoned rather than Gone. The story reports the platform as standing, on firelookout.com's word alone, and reports the cabin as moved.

A photographer's page reports 1931 photos of a tree lookout here and a 1940 date from a Kresek listing; firelookout.com gives 1937 for the platform. The story uses 1937 and reports the other claims as the photographer's.

sources.title: Whispers of the past at the Old Ochoco Ranger Station site

notes_for_editor: Sources conflict on design, date and status. Firelookout.com says the platform is still there, but gives no date for that; the FFLA index says Abandoned. The photographer's page (about 2001) reports 1931 photos of a tree lookout, a 1940 Kresek listing, and doubts the cabin came from this peak; Kresek's book was not read. Not used: a 1913 Crook County Journal item on Forest Lookouts' page that mentions a telephone at a lookout station on 'Black Butte', which may not be this peak. Record elevation_m 1617.3 was not checked against a source in this run. The cabin's current location rests on one 2023 article. A recent site visit or an Ochoco NF contact would settle the status. The 2023 article gives the site 25 miles south of Prineville in its lead and 25 miles east in another passage (the camp near the old ranger station); the story reports both.
